about_the_game:
About the Game
Step back in time to the Stone Age and embark on a charming adventure to find over 100 hidden cats scattered across hand-drawn prehistoric landscapes. Explore caves, ancient forests, and mysterious stone circles as you uncover these mischievous felines.

Relax and unleash your creativity by coloring black-and-white scenes with guided step-by-step palettes or create your own colorful masterpieces. Perfect for solo play or teaming up with a friend in online co-op mode!

Key Features:

  • Discover 100+ hidden cats in beautifully detailed Stone Age environments

  • Enjoy relaxing guided coloring or freeform painting with pastel tones

  • Special “Meow FM” radio brings soothing lo-fi and chillhop music to accompany your journey

  • Play solo or collaborate online with friends to find and color cats together

  • Compete in solo mode leaderboards and celebrate your achievements!

Dive into a prehistoric world full of fun, creativity, and feline surprises! 🐾🎨
